label: For "Macroeconomic Scenario Generation for Stress Tests": Generate internally consistent macroeconomic paths for stress testing, translating a narrative (for example a property crash) into variables used by credit and market models. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Fitting on 2010-2019 gives mild shocks.
